# SCM Fundamentals – Costs & Management


## Fundamentals of Supply Chain Management {#slide-52}

- Tasks, terms and concepts
- Objectives & trade-offs
- **Costs & management**

## Learning objectives {#learning-objectives-goals-costs}

After this unit you will be able to …

- **name** the key economic, ecological and social objectives of supply chain management,
- **analyse** trade-offs between service, inventory, transport, costs and sustainability,
- **explain and quantify** the main components of logistics costs,
- **select and interpret** suitable metrics for evaluating logistics decisions.

**Further reading**

- **Systems of objectives and cost models:** [@guenther2012produktion, chap. 1–3].
- **Performance and cost perspective of distribution logistics:** [@tripp2024distributions, chap. 1–4].
- **Sustainability as a corporate objective:** [@dyckhoff2008nachhaltige, chap. 1–3].

```{tikz}
% Centre
\node[
  circle,
  fill=black!35,
  text=white,
  minimum size=4cm,
  align=center,
  font=\LARGE\bfseries
] (center) at (0,0) {Target\\variables};

% Six target variables in a circle
\node[target, fill=green!100!black, text=black] (loyalty)
  at (0,2.55) {Delivery\\reliability};

\node[target, fill=orange!85!yellow, text=black] (quality)
  at (2.20,1.28) {Delivery\\quality};

\node[target, fill=blue!85!violet!50!white, text=black] (information)
  at (2.20,-1.28) {Information};

\node[target, fill=red, text=black] (costs)
  at (0,-2.55) {Costs};

\node[target, fill=green!60!black, text=black] (flexibility)
  at (-2.20,-1.28) {Flexibility};

\node[target, fill=green!85!yellow, text=black] (leadtime)
  at (-2.20,1.28) {Delivery\\time};

% Circular connecting arrows between centre and outer ring
% The curved arrows reflect the cyclical character of the original.
\draw[arrow] (center.north) to (loyalty.south);
\draw[arrow] (center.north east) to (quality.west);
\draw[arrow] (center.south east) to (information.west);
\draw[arrow] (center.south) to (costs.north);
\draw[arrow] (center.west) to (flexibility.north east);
\draw[arrow] (center.north west) to (leadtime.east);
\end{tikzpicture}
```
:::

:::: {.column width="50%"}
::: small-text
- **Delivery time**: time span between order placement and order fulfilment
- **Delivery reliability**: relationship between promised and actual delivery date
- **Delivery quality**: share of orders executed correctly in terms of quality and quantity
- **Flexibility/resilience**: feasibility of short-term changes in quantity, dates and specifications
- **Information**: quality and transparency of information in all phases of order processing
- **Costs**: efficiency of all logistics activities, total costs of logistics activities
:::

::::::

```{r}
library(plotly)

# Four vertices of the tetrahedron
# 1–3: base; 4: apex
punkte <- data.frame(
  ziel = c(
    "Quality",
    "Speed",
    "Costs",
    "Flexibility / resilience"
  ),
  x = c(-3.8,  0.0,  3.8,  0.0),
  y = c(-2.2,  3.2, -2.2,  0.0),
  z = c( 0.0,  0.0,  0.0,  4.2)
)

# Four triangular faces:
# base (0,1,2) and the three side faces to the apex (3).
faces_i <- c(0, 0, 0, 1)
faces_j <- c(1, 2, 3, 2)
faces_k <- c(2, 3, 1, 3)

fig <- plot_ly() |>
  add_trace(
    type = "mesh3d",
    x = punkte$x,
    y = punkte$y,
    z = punkte$z,
    i = faces_i,
    j = faces_j,
    k = faces_k,
    intensity = c(0.20, 0.55, 0.85, 1.00),
    colors = c("#FFF700", "#FFD000", "#F4B400", "#FFF9A8"),
    opacity = 0.78,
    flatshading = TRUE,
    showscale = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "skip",
    name = "Trade-off"
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    x = c(
      punkte$x[1], punkte$x[2], punkte$x[3], punkte$x[1], NA,
      punkte$x[1], punkte$x[4], NA,
      punkte$x[2], punkte$x[4], NA,
      punkte$x[3], punkte$x[4]
    ),
    y = c(
      punkte$y[1], punkte$y[2], punkte$y[3], punkte$y[1], NA,
      punkte$y[1], punkte$y[4], NA,
      punkte$y[2], punkte$y[4], NA,
      punkte$y[3], punkte$y[4]
    ),
    z = c(
      punkte$z[1], punkte$z[2], punkte$z[3], punkte$z[1], NA,
      punkte$z[1], punkte$z[4], NA,
      punkte$z[2], punkte$z[4], NA,
      punkte$z[3], punkte$z[4]
    ),
    line = list(color = "#1A1A1A", width = 7),
    hoverinfo = "skip",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    type = "scatter3d",
```

**Target profiles**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| out-width: "100%"

library(plotly)

scale_max <- 10

to_polygon <- function(top, right, bottom, left, name, color, dash = "solid") {
  data.frame(
    x = c(0, right, 0, -left, 0),
    y = c(top, 0, -bottom, 0, top),
    label = c("short delivery times", "high delivery reliability",
              "high delivery flexibility", "low logistics costs",
              "short delivery times"),
    profile = name,
    color = color,
    dash = dash
  )
}

p_red <- to_polygon(5.8, 8.7, 5.8, 1.8, "Profile 1", "#e53935", "solid")
p_blue <- to_polygon(7.6, 3.2, 8.6, 3.2, "Profile 2", "#3f51b5", "solid")
p_yellow <- to_polygon(9.3, 4.9, 1.5, 5.0, "Profile 3", "#e6df2a", "solid")
p_black <- to_polygon(3.6, 1.5, 3.6, 8.2, "Profile 4", "#333333", "dash")

profiles <- list(p_red, p_blue, p_yellow, p_black)

fig <- plot_ly()

# Axes
fig <- fig |>
  add_segments(
    x = -scale_max, xend = scale_max,
    y = 0, yend = 0,
    line = list(color = "#555555", width = 1.2),
    hoverinfo = "skip",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_segments(
    x = 0, xend = 0,
    y = -scale_max, yend = scale_max,
    line = list(color = "#555555", width = 1.2),
    hoverinfo = "skip",
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

# Arrowheads
arrow_len <- 0.7
arrow_w   <- 0.28

arrow_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(0, 0, scale_max, -scale_max),
  y = c(scale_max, -scale_max, 0, 0),
  ax = c(0, 0, -arrow_len, arrow_len),
  ay = c(-arrow_len, arrow_len, 0, 0)
)

for (i in 1:nrow(arrow_df)) {
  fig <- fig |>
    add_annotations(
      x = arrow_df$x[i], y = arrow_df$y[i],
      ax = arrow_df$ax[i] * 20, ay = arrow_df$ay[i] * 20,
      xref = "x", yref = "y", axref = "pixel", ayref = "pixel",
      text = "",
      showarrow = TRUE,
      arrowhead = 2,
      arrowsize = 1.3,
      arrowwidth = 1.4,
      arrowcolor = "#111111"
    )
}

# Profiles
for (p in profiles) {
  fig <- fig |>
    add_trace(
      data = p,
      x = ~x, y = ~y,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines",
      name = unique(p$profile),
      line = list(
        color = unique(p$color),
        width = ifelse(unique(p$dash) == "dash", 2, 2.2),
        dash = unique(p$dash)
      ),
      hovertemplate = paste0(unique(p$profile), "<extra></extra>")
    )
}

# Axis labels
fig <- fig |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 0, y = scale_max + 1.0,
    text = "short delivery times",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(size = 18, color = "#222")
  ) |>
  add_annotations(
    x = scale_max + 1.8, y = 0,
    text = "high<br>delivery reliability",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    xanchor = "left",
    font = list(size = 18, color = "#222")
  ) |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 0, y = -scale_max - 1.25,
    text = "high delivery flexibility",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(size = 18, color = "#222")
  ) |>
  add_annotations(
    x = -scale_max - 2.2, y = 0.1,
    text = "low<br>logistics costs",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    xanchor = "right",
    font = list(size = 18, color = "#222")
  ) |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 15, y = 9.7,
    text = "possible<br>target profiles<br>of a<br>system",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    align = "left",
    xanchor = "left",
    yanchor = "top",
    bordercolor = "#6f6f6f",
    borderwidth = 0,
    borderpad = 10,
    bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.96)",
    font = list(size = 18, color = "#222")
  )

fig <- fig |>
  layout(
    height = 480,
    width = 650,
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    margin = list(l = 120, r = 180, t = 30, b = 70),
    xaxis = list(
      visible = FALSE,
      range = c(-12.5, 13.2),
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      visible = FALSE,
      range = c(-11.5, 11.2),
      fixedrange = TRUE,
      scaleanchor = "x",
      scaleratio = 1
    ),
    legend = list(
      x = 0.80,
      y = 0.93,
      bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      borderwidth = 0,
      font = list(size = 14)
    )
  )

fig
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)

make_cost_tradeoff_plot <- function(
  titel,
  x_titel,
  x_vals,
  y_gesamt,
  y_kurve1,
  y_kurve2,
  label_gesamt = "Total costs",
  label_kurve1,
  label_kurve2,
  anno_gesamt,
  anno_kurve1,
  anno_kurve2,
  x_tickvals = NULL,
  x_ticktext = NULL,
  x_range = NULL,
  y_range = c(0.5, 9.3),
  height = 420,
  width = 600
) {

  fig <- plot_ly() |>
    add_trace(
      x = x_vals, y = y_gesamt,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
      line = list(color = "#7a7a7a", width = 2),
      name = label_gesamt,
      hovertemplate = paste0(label_gesamt, "<extra></extra>")
    ) |>
    add_trace(
      x = x_vals, y = y_kurve1,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
      line = list(color = "#9a9a9a", width = 2),
      name = label_kurve1,
      hovertemplate = paste0(label_kurve1, "<extra></extra>")
    ) |>
    add_trace(
      x = x_vals, y = y_kurve2,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
      line = list(color = "#9a9a9a", width = 2),
      name = label_kurve2,
      hovertemplate = paste0(label_kurve2, "<extra></extra>")
    )

  if (is.null(x_range)) {
    x_range <- c(min(x_vals) - 0.2, max(x_vals) + 0.2)
  }

  fig |>
    layout(
      showlegend = FALSE,
      height = height,
      width = width,
      margin = list(l = 70, r = 40, t = 60, b = 70),
      paper_bgcolor = "white",
      plot_bgcolor = "white",
      xaxis = list(
        title = x_titel,
        tickmode = if (!is.null(x_tickvals)) "array" else "linear",
        tickvals = x_tickvals,
        ticktext = x_ticktext,
        showline = TRUE,
        linewidth = 1.5,
        linecolor = "black",
        zeroline = FALSE,
        showgrid = FALSE,
        showticklabels = is.null(x_tickvals) || !all(is.na(x_ticktext)),
        range = x_range,
        fixedrange = TRUE
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "Costs",
        showline = TRUE,
        linewidth = 1.5,
        linecolor = "black",
        zeroline = FALSE,
        showgrid = FALSE,
        showticklabels = FALSE,
        range = y_range,
        fixedrange = TRUE
      ),
      annotations = list(
        list(
          x = mean(range(x_vals)),
          y = y_range - 0.15,
          text = titel,
          showarrow = FALSE,
          font = list(size = 18)
        ),
        c(
          list(
            text = label_gesamt,
            showarrow = TRUE,
            arrowhead = 0,
            font = list(size = 13)
          ),
          anno_gesamt
        ),
        c(
          list(
            text = label_kurve1,
            showarrow = TRUE,
            arrowhead = 0,
            font = list(size = 13)
          ),
          anno_kurve1
        ),
        c(
          list(
            text = label_kurve2,
            showarrow = TRUE,
            arrowhead = 0,
            font = list(size = 13)
          ),
          anno_kurve2
        )
      )
    )
}

x.val<- seq(1,5, length.out = 100)
y.1 <- 0.1*x.val^2
y.2 <- 1/x.val
y.g <- y.1 + y.2

```

::: small-text
- Conflicting cost components in many areas of logistics $\rightarrow$ a cost optimum exists (at least in theory)
- Logistics management means, among other things, making decisions about logistics systems
- Transparency of cost functions is sometimes severely limited
  - Data availability
  - Intertemporal attributability
  - Cost object assignment
  - Stochasticity
:::

::: callout-note

## Definition of sustainability (an attempt)

A social system is described as sustainable if it can be regarded as fair both intra- and intergenerationally. Fair means that it “meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs” [@hauff1987zukunft]

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const matrix = document.getElementById("eco-matrix");
  const dataNode = document.getElementById("eco-json");
  const panel = document.getElementById("info-panel");
  if (!matrix || !dataNode || !panel) return;

  matrix.innerHTML = `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 760 560" width="100%" style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">
      <line x1="70" y1="500" x2="710" y2="500" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"></line>
      <polygon points="710,500 695,492 695,508" fill="#333"></polygon>

      <line x1="70" y1="500" x2="70" y2="40" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"></line>
      <polygon points="70,40 62,55 78,55" fill="#333"></polygon>

      <text x="390" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#333">
        Ecological orientation
      </text>
      <text x="20" y="280" transform="rotate(-90 20 280)" text-anchor="middle"
            font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#333">
        Exposure
      </text>

      <text x="100" y="525" font-size="18" fill="#333">low</text>
      <text x="615" y="525" font-size="18" fill="#333">high</text>
      <text x="18" y="485" font-size="18" fill="#333">low</text>
      <text x="10" y="70" font-size="18" fill="#333">high</text>

      <g class="quad active" data-key="resistenz" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Ecological resistance">
        <rect x="80" y="50" width="300" height="210" fill="#d9d9d9" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" rx="4"></rect>
        <text x="230" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" fill="#333" pointer-events="none">
          <tspan x="230" dy="0">Ecological</tspan>
          <tspan x="230" dy="38">resistance</tspan>
        </text>
      </g>

      <g class="quad" data-key="adaption" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Ecological adaptation">
        <rect x="390" y="50" width="300" height="210" fill="#d9d9d9" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" rx="4"></rect>
        <text x="540" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" fill="#333" pointer-events="none">
          <tspan x="540" dy="0">Ecological</tspan>
          <tspan x="540" dy="38">adaptation</tspan>
        </text>
      </g>

      <g class="quad" data-key="ignoranz" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Ecological ignorance">
        <rect x="80" y="270" width="300" height="210" fill="#d9d9d9" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" rx="4"></rect>
        <text x="230" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" fill="#333" pointer-events="none">
          <tspan x="230" dy="0">Ecological</tspan>
          <tspan x="230" dy="38">ignorance</tspan>
        </text>
      </g>

      <g class="quad" data-key="offensive" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Ecological offensive">
        <rect x="390" y="270" width="300" height="210" fill="#d9d9d9" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" rx="4"></rect>
        <text x="540" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" fill="#333" pointer-events="none">
          <tspan x="540" dy="0">Ecological</tspan>
          <tspan x="540" dy="38">offensive</tspan>
        </text>
      </g>
    </svg>
  `;

  const ecoData = JSON.parse(dataNode.textContent);
  const quads = matrix.querySelectorAll(".quad");

  function renderPanel(key) {
    const d = ecoData[key];
    if (!d) return;

    const items = d.examples.map(ex => `
      <li>
        <b>${ex.name}</b> (${ex.sector})<br>
        ${ex.points.join("; ")}<br>
      </li>
    `).join("");

    panel.innerHTML = `
      <h3>${d.title}</h3>
      <p>${d.intro}</p>
      <ul>${items}</ul>
    `;

    quads.forEach(q => q.classList.remove("active"));
    const active = matrix.querySelector('.quad[data-key="' + key + '"]');
    if (active) active.classList.add("active");
  }

  quads.forEach(q => {
    q.addEventListener("click", function () {
      renderPanel(this.dataset.key);
    });
    q.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
        e.preventDefault();
        renderPanel(this.dataset.key);
      }
    });
  });

  renderPanel("resistenz");
});
</script>
```

```{=html}
          points: [
            "Slower mode of transport, usually with a lower climate impact",
            "Planning replaces a pure logic of acceleration",
            "Deceleration as a management decision"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  };

  const rowConfig = [
    {
      label: "Rules of<br>action",
      cols: 4,
      items: [
        { key: "handlungsregeln_1", html: "Keeping ecological<br>systems healthy" },
        { key: "handlungsregeln_2", html: "Respecting the<br>absorptive capacity<br>of ecological systems" },
        { key: "handlungsregeln_3", html: "Balanced use of<br>renewable resources" },
        { key: "handlungsregeln_4", html: "Balanced use of<br>non-renewable resources" }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Basic<br>strategies",
      cols: 3,
      items: [
        { key: "strategie_suffizienz", html: "Sufficiency" },
        { key: "strategie_effizienz", html: "Efficiency" },
        { key: "strategie_konsistenz", html: "Consistency" }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Basic<br>principles",
      cols: 4,
      items: [
        { key: "prinzip_verantwortung", html: "Responsibility<br>principle" },
        { key: "prinzip_kooperation", html: "Cooperation<br>principle" },
        { key: "prinzip_kreislauf", html: "Circularity principle" },
        { key: "prinzip_funktion", html: "Principle of<br>function<br>orientation" }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Concepts",
      cols: 4,
      items: [
        { key: "konzept_entstofflichung", html: "Dematerialisation" },
        { key: "konzept_energieeffizienz", html: "Increasing energy<br>efficiency" },
        { key: "konzept_entflechtung", html: "Decoupling" },
        { key: "konzept_entschleunigung", html: "Deceleration" }
      ]
    }
  ];

  const rowsWrap = document.getElementById("eco-matrix-rows");
  const detail = document.getElementById("eco-detail");
  if (!rowsWrap || !detail) return;

  function renderDetail(key) {
    const d = ecoData[key];
    if (!d) return;

    document.querySelectorAll("#eco-matrix-rows .eco-cell").forEach(el => {
      el.classList.toggle("active", el.dataset.key === key);
    });

    detail.innerHTML = `
      <div class="eco-card">
        <div class="eco-minihead">${d.subtitle}</div>
        <h3>${d.title}</h3>
        <p>${d.intro}</p>
        ${d.examples.map(ex => `
          <div class="eco-example">
            <h4>${ex.name}</h4>
            <div class="eco-sector">${ex.sector}</div>
            <ul>
              ${ex.points.map(p => `<li>${p}</li>`).join("")}
            </ul>
          </div>
        `).join("")}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  rowsWrap.innerHTML = "";

  rowConfig.forEach(row => {
    const rowEl = document.createElement("div");
    rowEl.className = "eco-row";

    const labelEl = document.createElement("div");
    labelEl.className = "eco-row-label";
    labelEl.innerHTML = row.label;

    const itemsEl = document.createElement("div");
    itemsEl.className = `eco-row-items cols-${row.cols}`;

    row.items.forEach(item => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "eco-cell";
      btn.dataset.key = item.key;
      btn.innerHTML = item.html;
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => renderDetail(item.key));
      itemsEl.appendChild(btn);
    });

    rowEl.appendChild(labelEl);
    rowEl.appendChild(itemsEl);
    rowsWrap.appendChild(rowEl);
  });

  renderDetail("handlungsregeln_1");
})();
</script>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(plotly)
library(htmltools)

make_matrix_plot <- function(show_quadrants = FALSE,
                             show_items = FALSE,
                             highlight_right = FALSE) {

  items <- data.frame(
    name = c("Clothing", "Furniture", "Packaging", "Steel",
             "Smartphones", "Computers", "Cars", "Household appliances"),
    x = c(-7.2, -5.9, -6.6, -8.1, 4.3, 5.5, 6.6, 4.6),
    y = c(7.2, 0.9, -3.9, -7.1, 6.6, 4.8, -1.0, -6.3)
  )

  quads <- data.frame(
    xmin = c(-9, 0, -9, 0),
    xmax = c(0, 9, 0, 9),
    ymin = c(0, 0, -9, -9),
    ymax = c(9, 9, 0, 0),
    fill = c("rgba(63,127,146,0.08)",
             "rgba(63,127,146,0.12)",
             "rgba(63,127,146,0.08)",
             "rgba(63,127,146,0.12)")
  )

  quad_text <- data.frame(
    text = c(
      "<b><i>Design for<br>Recycling</i></b>",
      "<b><i>Design for Remanufacture &<br>Reuse</i></b>",
      "<b><i>Design for<br>Recycled Content</i></b>",
      "<b><i>Design for<br>Repair & Durability</i></b>"
    ),
    x = c(-2.8, 4.5, -3.1, 3.9),
    y = c(1.8, 1.8, -1.9, -1.9)
  )

  axis_col <- "#3b7f92"
  txt_col  <- "#463f3a"
  red_col  <- "#d7191c"

  fig <- plot_ly()

  fig <- fig |>
    add_trace(
      x = c(-9.5, 9.5), y = c(-9, 9.5),
      type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
      marker = list(opacity = 0),
      hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE
    )

  shape_list <- list()

  if (show_quadrants) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(quads))) {
      shape_list[[length(shape_list) + 1]] <- list(
        type = "rect",
        x0 = quads$xmin[i], x1 = quads$xmax[i],
        y0 = quads$ymin[i], y1 = quads$ymax[i],
        line = list(width = 0),
        fillcolor = quads$fill[i],
        layer = "below"
      )
    }
  }

  if (highlight_right) {
    shape_list[[length(shape_list) + 1]] <- list(
      type = "rect",
      x0 = 0, x1 = 9,
      y0 = -9, y1 = 9,
      line = list(color = "rgba(215,25,28,0.7)", width = 2),
      fillcolor = "rgba(215,25,28,0.05)",
      layer = "below"
    )
  }

  shape_list <- c(
    shape_list,
    list(
      list(type = "line", x0 = -8.9, x1 = 8.6, y0 = 0, y1 = 0,
           line = list(color = axis_col, width = 4)),
      list(type = "path",
           path = "M 8.6 0 L 8.05 0.35 L 8.20 0 L 8.05 -0.35 Z",
           fillcolor = axis_col,
           line = list(color = axis_col, width = 2)),
      list(type = "path",
           path = "M -8.9 0 L -8.35 0.35 L -8.50 0 L -8.35 -0.35 Z",
           fillcolor = axis_col,
           line = list(color = axis_col, width = 2)),
      list(type = "line", x0 = 0, x1 = 0, y0 = -8.5, y1 = 8.6,
           line = list(color = axis_col, width = 4)),
      list(type = "path",
           path = "M 0 8.6 L 0.35 8.05 L 0 8.2 L -0.35 8.05 Z",
           fillcolor = axis_col,
           line = list(color = axis_col, width = 2)),
      list(type = "path",
           path = "M 0 -8.5 L 0.35 -7.95 L 0 -8.10 L -0.35 -7.95 Z",
           fillcolor = axis_col,
           line = list(color = axis_col, width = 2))
    )
  )

  ann <- list(
    list(
      x = 0, y = 9.25,
      text = "Customer<br>preferences",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 20, color = txt_col)
    ),
    list(
      x = 0.4, y = 8.15,
      text = "<i>dynamic</i>",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(size = 15, color = txt_col)
    ),
    list(
      x = 0.4, y = -8.55,
      text = "<i>static</i>",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(size = 15, color = txt_col)
    ),
    list(
      x = -8.95, y = -0.7,
      text = "<i>low</i>",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 15, color = txt_col)
    ),
    list(
      x = 8.2, y = 0.85,
      text = "<i>high</i>",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 15, color = txt_col)
    ),
    list(
      x = 9.2, y = 0.1,
      text = "Product<br>complexity",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(size = 20, color = txt_col)
    )
  )

  if (show_quadrants) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(quad_text))) {
      ann[[length(ann) + 1]] <- list(
        x = quad_text$x[i],
        y = quad_text$y[i],
        text = quad_text$text[i],
        showarrow = FALSE,
        align = "center",
        font = list(size = 19, color = txt_col)
      )
    }
  }

  if (show_items) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(items))) {
      ann[[length(ann) + 1]] <- list(
        x = items$x[i],
        y = items$y[i],
        text = paste0("<b>", items$name[i], "</b>"),
        showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "center",
        yanchor = "middle",
        font = list(size = 15, color = txt_col),
        bgcolor = "white",
        bordercolor = red_col,
        borderwidth = 2,
        borderpad = 6
      )
    }
  }

  fig |>
    layout(
      width = 1200,
      height = 700,
      paper_bgcolor = "white",
      plot_bgcolor = "white",
      margin = list(l = 10, r = 90, t = 10, b = 10),
      xaxis = list(
        visible = FALSE,
        range = c(-9.5, 9.5),
        fixedrange = TRUE
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        visible = FALSE,
        range = c(-9, 9.5),
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        scaleanchor = "x",
        scaleratio = 1
      ),
      shapes = shape_list,
      annotations = ann
    ) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

make_matrix_plot(show_quadrants = FALSE, show_items = FALSE)
```

## Case example SushiFresh GmbH {#slide-sushifresh-idee}
::: slide-subtitle
The business idea
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
**SushiFresh GmbH** is a start-up offering **sushi boxes freshly made every day** in a German metropolitan region.

- **Promise:** “Made today, sold today” – restaurant-quality sushi, but without the wait
- **Production:** one central kitchen, production in the early morning hours
- **Sales channel:** supermarkets (shelf sales)
- **Range:** approx. 12 boxes (classic, vegetarian, vegan)
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
::: {.callout-note}

## Key facts 

- Shelf life: max. 24–36 hours
- Cold chain: continuously 0–4 °C
- Ingredients: rice, nori, vegetables (regional), salmon and tuna (imported)
- Demand: highly volatile (weekday, weather, events)
- Market launch: growth from 3 to 30 points of sale planned
:::
:::
::::

---

## Case example SushiFresh GmbH {#slide-sushifresh-fragen}
::: slide-subtitle
Discussion
:::

:::: {.columns .smaller-text}
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Guiding questions: strategic position**

::: {.fragment}
- Which **customer groups** and needs drive the positioning – price, freshness, convenience or sustainability?
- How does SushiFresh differ from **competitors** (restaurants, delivery services, supermarket sushi)?
- Which **trade-offs** arise (freshness vs. costs vs. waste vs. environment)?
- Where does the company sit between **efficiency and responsiveness**? Which target variables are strategically important?
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment}
**Guiding questions: supply chain structure**

- How does the supply chain deal with **volatile demand** and highly perishable goods?
- How can the **cold chain and freshness** be ensured along the entire chain?
- Which **stages and partners** belong to the supply chain (suppliers, kitchen, logistics, retail)?
- How should the supply chain be structured: **centralisation vs. decentralisation**?
- What **depth of value creation** could SushiFresh aim for? (e.g. in-house logistics?)

:::
:::
::::

::: {.fragment}
> **Objective:** Prepare a strategic analysis of SushiFresh's business model. Derive a suitable supply chain structure.
:::
